_comment: The editorial list of ChEBI entries. One line of justification per entry, per docs/architecture/115 section 4.5. Ids were RESOLVED against the real 3-star name index, never typed from memory, so no id here is invented. `alias` is OUR common name for a compound ChEBI files under a systematic one; it is shown BESIDE the ChEBI name, never instead of it. `family` groups entries into quiz levels; distractors come from the same family.
